ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, managers, and commercial partners against the French national freezing lists (Direction Générale du Trésor under CMF Article L562-2), the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (EU Regulations 2580/2001, 269/2010 and 833/2014), the UN Security Council Consolidated List, and OFAC SDN list as enhanced KYC; PEP status is checked against French public officials, EU/international PEP registers, and adverse media databases; positive PEP or sanctions hits require enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth/source-of-funds documentation and TRACFIN reporting where applicable before filing incorporation documents.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formations des Entreprises operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI), at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be written in Latin characters; names in non-Latin scripts (e.g., Chinese) must be transliterated and, where required, accompanied by a faithful French translation (Loi Toubon). The name must be distinctive within the National Trade and Companies Register (RCS) and must not infringe prior marks, official emblems, or regulated industry terms. The legal form must appear as 'SARL' or 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée' in all formal documents.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Avocat, Notaire, Huissier de justice, Commissaire aux comptes
République, Ministère, État, Armée, Police, Mairie
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Guichet Unique or the registry (Greffe du tribunal de commerce) rejects the proposed name, the applicant may cure the deficiency and resubmit within 15 days. A final adverse decision may be challenged by a free-form administrative appeal (recours gracieux or recours hiérarchique) submitted to the Director of INPI within two months of the decision, or by a petition before the competent commercial court in accordance with Articles R123-30 and R123-31 of the Code de commerce; the judicial route is exercised in référé and must attach the registry's written contrary decision and supporting evidence of trademark/name coexistence.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partially permissible. A French SARL may use an authorized commercial domiciliation company as its registered office under Article L123-11-1 of the Code de commerce, subject to a five-year maximum and surrender of physical mail-handling services. However, for the target online dietary supplements business, a purely virtual office without a managed correspondence service and without demonstrable commercial substance is not acceptable for DGCCRF notification, merchant acquiring, or French customs formalities; banks and the registries will require a physical operating or domiciliation address with documented personnel/authorized signatory presence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High risk: there is an estimated 60% likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months of operation, triggered by DGCCRF monitoring of dietary supplements (Article L511-7 Code de la consommation) and French Customs anti-fraud controls; the risk is materially enhanced when the registered office is a purely virtual mailing address.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 and R.223-1 et seq. (SARL formation and governance); Articles R.123-1 et seq. (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés); Directive (EU) 2017/1132 as transposed by Decree No. 2021-1554 (cross-border registration framework).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered-office department, operating the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), with mandatory electronic filing via the single portal formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts de constitution (Articles of Association) executed as a private or notarial deed, accompanied by the standardized CERFA 13912*07 / M0 incorporation declaration (Demande d'immatriculation) filed through the Guichet des Formalités des Entreprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital applies to a French SARL (minimum_capital_requirement: false). Under Article L.223-7 of the Commercial Code, at least 20% of subscribed cash capital must be paid into a blocked escrow deposit account at incorporation, with the balance payable within five (5) years; the deposit must be certified by a bank-issued attestation de dépôt des fonds, released only upon production of the RCS registration certificate (K-bis).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, unanimously by the founding shareholders: (1) That the share capital of the SARL in the amount of EUR 10,000 is fully subscribed as set forth in the Articles of Association and that twenty percent thereof is deposited into the statutory escrow account opened with a licensed French bank; (2) That the registered office is fixed at the address indicated in the Articles, which shall be the Company's statutory seat for RCS registration; (3) That the undersigned founding member is appointed as first Gérant with unlimited day-to-day management powers; (4) That the Gérant is instructed to file the incorporation dossier with the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce and to undertake all administrative formalities. Unanimously adopted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Preparation and Execution of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders and, where elected, a Notaire (French civil-law notary); fiscal registration by the Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) only if optional deed registration is chosen.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles in French stating (i) corporate name, (ii) SARL legal form, (iii) share capital and in-kind contribution valuation, (iv) registered office address, (v) corporate purpose restricted to online retail of dietary supplements and nutraceuticals (ISIC 4791) excluding any licensed pharmacy or medicinal-product activity, (vi) duration of 99 years, and (vii) management and signature provisions. Have each founder sign the statuts personally with a feuille de présence; if in-kind contributions exceed EUR 30,000 or reach 50% of capital, appoint a commissaire aux apports for valuation certification. Preserve the original executed deed exclusively for the RCS filing.
required_dossiers: Executed Articles of Association (statuts)
Passports or national identity cards of every shareholder
Proof of address of each shareholder (issued within the last 3 months)
Feuille de présence / signed signature page
Commissaire aux apports report (if in-kind contribution exists)
Beneficial-owner declaration (CERFA 51007#08)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe queries the statuts (e.g., contradictory management clauses or a missing beneficial-owner declaration), cure the defect by filing a corrigendum rectification within 15 days under Article R.123-105 of the Commercial Code and re-submit the corrected CERFA form without an additional state fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Deposit in Blocked Escrow Account and Bank Certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A licensed credit institution or deposit house operating in France, acting as capital depositary for the SARL in formation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional capital-subscription account in the name of the 'SARL [Name] en constitution'. Deposit the mandatory minimum of 20% of subscribed share capital pursuant to Article L.223-7; for this high-risk nutraceutical e-commerce business, paid-up capital is prudentially set at EUR 10,000 to evidence substance to acquirers and correspondent banks. Obtain the original attestation de dépôt des fonds from the bank itemizing subscriber identities and amounts, conditioned on sole release against the future K-bis extract. For high-risk merchant-account onboarding, retain the wire/transfer KYC with source-of-funds evidence covering the whole capital payment.
required_dossiers: Bank deposit receipt confirming credited amounts
Attestation de dépôt des fonds (statutory capital block certificate)
Shareholder payment instructions and banking KYC/AML source-of-funds documentation
High-Risk_Special_License customer due diligence file (beneficial owners, business rationale, anticipated payment rails)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the bank procrastinates release or certification on AML/Sanctions grounds, provide an enhanced due diligence pack (source of funds, trade contract, licence notification evidence) or transfer the deposit to a second French credit institution; any institution change must be reflected by an amend to the statuts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized journal of legal announcements (Journal d'Annonces Légales) valid in the department of the registered office and accepted by the Greffe.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Order and validate the legal notice indicating the exact company name, 'SARL' legal form, share capital, registered office, corporate purpose (online dietary supplements and nutraceuticals), duration, and the listing RCS court. The journal issues an attestation de parution (publication certificate); ensure the statutory seven-day registration window is observed before submission to the Greffe. Keep the invoices and publication proofs in the company register.
required_dossiers: Legal notice draft and order form
Attestation de parution (publication certificate)
Publisher invoice evidencing publication fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On a defective publication (wrong capital, office, or business purpose), revert to the journal for a pro-bono corrigendum and transmit the corrected attestation to the Greffe prior to registration; on total rejection, purchase a new slot (approx. EUR 126–170) and re-issue the notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Filing of the Incorporation Dossier at the Greffe
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via the single official portal formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (guichet des formalités des entreprises).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the single CERFA 13912*07 / M0 declaration, append a certified scanned copy of the signed statuts, the bank attestation de dépôt des fonds, the attestation de parution, proof of enjoyment of the registered office, identity and address evidences of the shareholders and the Gérant, the beneficial-owner declaration, and the non-conviction/compatibility declaration of the legal representative. Pay the consolidated greffe fee covering RCS enrollment and mandatory levies. Upon successful processing the Greffe issues the K-bis extract and commences INSEE SIREN/SIRET assignment.
required_dossiers: Signed Articles of Association (certified copy uploaded on the portal)
Attestation de dépôt des fonds
Attestation de parution of the legal announcement
CERFA 13912*07 (single M0 declaration)
Proof of use of registered office (lease, ownership title, or free-occupancy deed)
Identity and address proofs of all shareholders and the appointed Gérant
Beneficial-owner declaration (CERFA 51007#08)
Non-conviction and legal-capacity statement of the legal representative
Power of attorney if filed through a professional intermediary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe returns an incomplete-file notice, regularized under Article R.123-104 within 15 working days by uploading the missing evidence on the portal; upon failure the application is rejected with fee refund and a fresh dossier must be filed without prejudice to founding acts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Tax IDs, Employer Registration, and Customs Enrolment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INSEE (SIRENE database), Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), URSSAF, and the Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI) for EORI.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon delivery of the K-bis extract, activate the SIREN/SIRET identifiers, apply to DGFiP for the intra-Community and VAT number (Article 286 CGI) covering cross-border sales, register with URSSAF for eventual payroll and social contributions, and apply for the EORI number (FR + SIREN) to operate customs clearances for imported nutraceutical stock. Furnish the K-bis and licence anticipation letters to the acquiring bank as proof of corporate existence for the High_Risk_Merchant_Account and card-present / e-commerce rails.
required_dossiers: K-bis extract (latest original from the Greffe)
INSEE notice of SIREN/SIRET attribution
DGFiP acknowledgment of VAT / intra-Community registration
URSSAF employer registration receipt
DGDDI EORI application and customs import profile
Bank KYC renewal pack including the national supplement notification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGFiP or URSSAF rejects registration on documentation grounds, re-submit with the K-bis plus a signed address-confirmation letter of the Gérant; if the EORI request is refused due to mismatched business address, cure by updating the RCS entry and providing a registered-office evidencing lease.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — French tax authority; online portal impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities without a French permanent establishment must register for French VAT by filing Form 3550 (or online through the non-resident taxpayer service at impots.gouv.fr) with the competent Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE); the applicant is assigned an individual tax identification number (SIREN) and a French VAT number (FR followed by a two-digit key and SIREN). A French SARL obtains its SIREN automatically upon incorporation and its VAT number is derived from SIREN; the TIN is the SIREN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: French law does not provide a US-style check-the-box election. A multi-member SARL is mandatorily subject to corporate income tax (IS). An EURL (single-member SARL) may elect to be taxed as a corporation (IS) instead of being transparent in the hands of the individual member; civil companies may elect partnership taxation under Article 1655 bis CGI. Hybrid mismatch rules under ATAD impose mandatory disallowance, with no elective opt-in or opt-out election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée — TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For a French-established SARL, the VAT registration threshold under the franchise en base is €91,900 for supplies of goods and €36,300 for service supplies; mandatory VAT registration applies above these thresholds, and no threshold applies to non-established foreign suppliers making taxable supplies in France.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping mandate exists in France. Mandatory B2B e-invoicing will be phased in from September 2026, requiring electronic invoices (Factur-X or EDI) transmitted through the French Portail Public de Facturation (PPF) using certified dematerialisation platforms. B2C e-commerce and cross-border supplies are subject to OSS/IOSS reporting but not real-time transaction clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods physically delivered to destinations outside the European Union are eligible for VAT zero-rating under Article 262-1 CGI, provided the exporter retains proof of export. Intra-EU supplies of goods to taxable dealers in other member states may also be zero-rated under Article 262-0 CGI, subject to the customer's valid EU VAT identification number and inclusion in the recapitulative statement (EC Sales List). Services physically and effectively related to exports qualify for zero-rating under Article 259 A CGI. For an online retail business selling dietary supplements, zero-rating applies when title is obtained by a non-EU customer and the goods are transported out of the EU.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAU), Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, and transport documentation evidencing physical movement outside the EU
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent export zero-rating claims are subject to VAT reassessment, late interest (intérêts de retard), and the 80% bad-faith penalty under Article 1729 CGI (or 40% for substantial undervaluation), plus potential criminal fines under Articles 1741 and 1742 CGI. In addition, the DGFiP routinely scrutinises export documentation nil-value or missing transport evidence, and a retrospective clawback of improperly zero-rated VAT may extend up to the normal statutory limitation period (six years, or ten years in cases of bad faith under Article L.176 of the Livre des procédures fiscales).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Central Bank of France) and Direction Générale du Trésor (DGT), Ministry of Economy and Finance
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France operates a fully convertible euro regime with unrestricted capital and current account convertibility. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are permitted without FX surrender obligations, subject only to standard corporate dividend withholding tax (12.8% plus social charges) and beneficial ownership declarations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or conversion ratio applies to euro-denominated or intra-EU transactions. For non-eurozone exports, French SARLs must file a customs declaration (DAU) and may retain or freely convert foreign exchange proceeds. Large transactions above €100,000 require tax authority reporting within 30 days via the Impôts framework.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility for offshore EMIs due to French ACPR licensing requirements and elevated AML risk classification for dietary supplement e-commerce; licensed French banks with cross-border treasury desks remain the primary channel.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote digital KYC and video verification permitted for French SARLs via Banque de France-compliant platforms; however, physical presence of directors or authorized signatories is mandatory for high-risk onboarding involving cross-border trade volumes exceeding €500,000 annually.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk merchant account designation for nutraceutical online retail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid SARL registration certificate, SIREN/SIRET, VAT number, product supplier contracts, health claim certifications, and beneficial ownership register extract

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border payment flows from jurisdictions with elevated sanctions exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Import/export declarations, payment purpose codes, and third-party compliance screening reports

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity injections routed via SWIFT MT103 using purpose code 'EQ' or descriptive text 'Capital contribution to French SARL'. Verification requires Banque de France central bank reporting, corporate registry extract (Kbis), and board resolution. Dedicated treasury accounts with dual-signature controls are mandatory for amounts exceeding €100,000.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements executed through SWIFT MT103 or MT202 with supporting commercial invoices, packing lists, and proof of delivery. Commercial Letters of Credit (LCs) available via correspondent banks for transactions above €250,000. All disbursements require French tax authority pre-approval for high-value FX conversions.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Currency forwards for EUR/USD and EUR/GBP pairs
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for emerging market currencies
Cross-currency interest rate swaps for multi-currency liquidity optimization

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval of annual accounts and allocation of profit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the financial year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court injunction to convene the meeting or file accounts; potential civil liability of the gérant. No automatic strike-off solely for one missed approval.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of annual accounts and required accounting documents
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises, transmitted to the competent commercial court registry and RNE
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval; two months when filed electronically
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court injunction and potential fine of EUR 1,500, increased to EUR 3,000 for repeat non-compliance; prolonged inactivity or unresolved non-compliance may support administrative dissolution or strike-off procedures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return and annual tax package
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after financial year-end; for a 31 December year-end, generally by the second business day after 1 May
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing interest and penalties, generally a 10% surcharge, increased penalties for formal notice or fraudulent conduct, and possible tax audit.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner register review and confirmation of accuracy
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate records; changes filed through the Guichet unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Review annually; file changes within 30 days after any change in beneficial ownership or control
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court order to comply, criminal penalties for inaccurate or omitted information, and potential liability of the legal representative; no separate annual confirmation filing is required.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor is generally mandatory when the SARL exceeds at least two of three thresholds: EUR 5 million total balance sheet, EUR 10 million net turnover, and 50 average employees. Appointment may also be required for certain group relationships or shareholder requests.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP under the French Accounting Standards Authority (ANC) rules for individual statutory accounts. IFRS is generally not used for standalone SARL statutory accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not impose a standalone annual UBO confirmation filing. The SARL must perform an annual internal verification and file an update within 30 days of any change. Transfers of SARL shares require a written transfer instrument, compliance with third-party approval rules where applicable, update of shareholder records, and UBO filing if beneficial ownership or control changes.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of shareholders and share transfers
Register of management decisions and corporate minutes
Beneficial-owner register and supporting identification records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Approximately USD 650-1,950 per year, depending on location and service scope
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Approximately USD 4,000-12,000 per year for a small SARL subject to mandatory statutory audit

stage_6.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard rate, fiscal years ending on or after 31 Dec 2022)
stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced rate of 15% on first €42,000 of taxable profit for SMEs meeting turnover/capital conditions; Research Tax Credit (Crédit Impôt Recherche) and Innovation Tax Credit (Crédit Impôt Innovation) where eligible; territorial distribution incentives do not alter headline rate.
stage_6.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (no year limit; annual offset limited to €1,000,000 plus 50% of taxable profit exceeding €1,000,000)
